en: Illustrated vintage postcard showing a scene from the Schlossberg hill in Graz. On the left stands a round tower with a domed roof surrounded by trees. To the right are multi‑arched fortification walls with greenery on top. A curved pathway runs through the middle with a few people in old-fashioned clothing walking toward an arched gateway in the background. The title text is printed in red at the top.
